response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_tat_difference FROM Laboratory AS l WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS q WHERE q.ID = l.ID AND q."U-PRO" = '-' AND q.RA = '-') GROUP BY l.ID) SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS average_pt, AVG(avg_tat_difference) AS average_tat_difference FROM patient_averages
